title: Old man Kimball on bass and Desdunes as a violinist
summary: They sort out that the bass-playing Kimball is Henry Kimball, father of the younger Norvin, and Harry recalls Desdunes as a good violinist.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique
